blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Philippines will welcome the next generation of Asian sepak takraw talents as it hosts the inaugural ASTAF U-19 Asian Sepak Takraw Championship 2026 from November 26 to 30 in Manila. The hosting comes on the heels of another notable campaign for Philippine sepak takraw at the Asian Games in Nagoya, Japan, where Cebuana Jean Marie Sucalit captured a silver medal in the women’s doubles event. Sucalit, a native of Catmon in northern Cebu, teamed up with Philippine captain and feeder Abegail Sinogbuhan to reach the finals before settling for silver after losing to Vietnam, 8-15, 4-15.
